scope: Every subject, every MCP tool, every learning mode, every teaching artifact and every future host generation
source_of_truth: complete Obsidian Markdown; HTML is a shorter interactive projection
workflow: Read actual authoritative sources with host tools and record precise evidence; do not infer source reading from an MCP call.
Diagnose prerequisites without fabricating learner answers; include a beginner refresher and define every new symbol.
Write the complete canonical Markdown first, with a resource block at the top and reciprocal resolvable vault-root wikilinks.
For every teaching point explain the mechanism, every derivation or operation step and why that step is valid.
Add verified worked examples, boundary cases, misconception correction, contrasting cases, graduated exercises and a transfer task.
For every visualizable point provide a labeled diagram and a meaningful controllable step/animation/parameter view; otherwise explain why text is the appropriate representation.
Produce a self-contained offline HTML projection with wide desktop layout, responsive mobile layout and accessible reduced-motion controls.
Register the complete Markdown/HTML pair with save_teaching_package; register each assessment item before asking it.
Run all interaction paths, wrong and boundary inputs, Markdown coverage, backlink resolution, desktop and mobile checks.
Collect raw answers and hint level; semantic reasoning needs host review, Runtime alone updates evidence, retention and progression.

depth.prerequisites: Teach the prerequisite needed for this step, not merely its name; explain terms, notation, units and input constraints.
depth.principle: Explain why it works and the conditions that make the claim true. No unsupported universal promise that every beginner has mastered it.
depth.steps: An ordered list of at least two complete operations or derivation steps with explanations; no 'obvious', 'similarly' or omitted intermediate result in place of teaching.
depth.worked_example: State the exact inputs and assumptions, show all steps and independently check the result.
depth.misconceptions: Give the incorrect idea, explain its error and repair it; never score prose by the presence of those words.
depth.boundaries: Cover zero/negative/empty/undefined inputs and domain-specific model limits that apply; avoid claiming an irrelevant case is supported.
depth.comparison: Contrast a correct method or condition with a nearby case for which it fails.
depth.practice: Provide basic, variation and challenge tasks with complete solutions and wrong-answer explanations.
depth.transfer: Change inputs, context or constraints; ask the learner to explain which principle carries over.

visualization.priority: visual first where a picture reveals structure, mechanism or state
visualization.no_visual_exception: Record an explicit pedagogical reason for a nonvisualizable point, not a blanket omission.
visualization.truth_boundary: Graphs and sampled simulations illustrate; analytical reasoning or full checks establish conclusions.

layout.paragraph_readability: Use columns, subsections, diagrams and comparison panels instead of a narrow whole-page cap.
layout.mobile_rule: stack panels and keep page scrollWidth <= viewport width; code/table panels may scroll within their own container

markdown.states: Learner state in Markdown is explicitly a Runtime snapshot, never authoritative local mastery.
markdown.coverage: Compare visible teaching prose and formulas, not HTML/CSS/JS character count. Keep all projected content plus additional original explanation and examples in Markdown.

learning_resources.placement: At the top of each teaching document, before lesson content
learning_resources.prefer: Precisely relevant videos only after verifying URL accessibility, title/publisher, actual topical content and a useful timestamp or section.
learning_resources.unverified_video_rule: Omit the video completely; no guessed title, invented URL or availability guarantee.
learning_resources.fallback: Use precise topic + skill/operation + level search terms, with separate core/extension/advanced suggestions; label them as queries rather than sources read.
learning_resources.no_future_guarantee: Verification describes the checked moment only; every later generation rechecks or falls back to keywords.

verification.runtime: Checks structural records, stored content coverage and provenance fields; it does not establish semantic or mathematical truth.
host: independently solve and check every exercise
forbidden: submitting a path without the teaching bodies as proof of quality
